The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, oldest first within each priority. The region manager tests pass (6 of 6, including a new one for your example).

- **`src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`** (`findOpenSupportTicketsOfCustomersInRegion`, about line 5277): the query now calls `.highestPriorityFirst()`, the same builder step the sales-rep list uses. Its Javadoc says so. The region overview is the only caller.
- **`src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/RegionManagerTest.java`**: new test `openTicketsOfTheRegionAreListedHighestPriorityFirstThenOldest`. It uses your T-1 to T-5 example plus a closed high-priority ticket, and checks the order T-3, T-5, T-2, T-4, T-1.

Nothing is committed.
